checks.text:
The radio's still on. Through the hiss, a voice on the police band:
'...Alpha team will fly the Arklay range at dusk... searching for Bravo...'
They're coming. Tonight.

The station log. Every hour, to the minute.
0815 POLICE BAND. STARS ALPHA TO FLY AT DUSK. ASKED WIND ON RIDGE.
0840 CROWS AT THE GLASS AGAIN. HUNDREDS.
His tea's beside it, cold. A crow came through the window and died on his desk.

A barograph. The pen is still drawing.
The pressure's falling.
His bed. Unmade. A photo of a woman by the pillow.
His coat's still on the hook. Wherever he went, he went in a hurry.
A pencil, dropped on the floor.
July. Every day crossed off up to yesterday.

entry: A radio. It's on. Someone could hear me.
notes: high in the south-west corner: the instrument bench, the radio desk under the broken window
high in the north-east corner: the bunk, the stove, the coat on its hook, the open door
high in the north-west corner: the radio and the log, the chair rolled off, the door
